headline: US to Terminate South Africa and Rwanda AGOA Trade Benefits in 2027
summary: The United States is moving to terminate South Africa and Rwanda's eligibility for the African Growth and Opportunity Act (AGOA), ending their preferential access to the US market from January 1, 2027.
why: AGOA provides duty-free access to the US market for eligible Sub-Saharan African nations, making the loss of benefits a significant trade headwind for affected exporters.

impacts.name: South Africa
impacts.why: Termination of preferential trade access under AGOA threatens export volumes to the US.
